summary: Verdict: the three tracks are individually strong but do NOT share a data model yet, and the final gamification spec silently assumes a program (bell reachable, structured rules, Muster week) and a sync model (owner-written state/week files) that neither final_program.json nor final_arch.json actually provides. Cross-reference results: (1) every exercise_id in the gamification region_weights table, every gear-slot ladder reference (farmer_carry/pike_push_up/diamond_push_up/db_row/calf_raise step thresholds), every gate expression and all six bb_* benchmark ids resolve against final_program.json; the only program things the spec references that the program lacks are the Muster week (week 0, Wed–Sat), the week-12 taper (Fri off) and a Skirmish table. (2) The architecture's data/program.json excerpt is a DIFFERENT program (workouts A–F by session-count rotation, ladders pushup/squat/hinge-with-swing-merged/press/row/plank/tm-*, stepIds like pushup.floor, an assessment with pushup/squatBw/plankSec/gobletTrial/pressTrial/hinge/walkMph fields, benchmarks pushup-max/plank-max/squat-bw-max/mile-time/swing-form-check) and its gamification.json is a different economy (triangular levels, 5 ranks, crown-per-category duel with absolute XP/zone-2/sessions, count-based bosses, hard-break streak). duo.json uses a third benchmark set (push_max, plank_hold_s, swing_test 60 s, treadmill_12min_m, zone2_hold_min) with 0–5 tiers and different boss names/HP. All of these must be regenerated from the final gamification spec + program; none of the arch's fixture data survives. (3) The architecture's event model can carry every field in data_fields_required and duo.json data_needed once ~9 event types and a field-level redaction layer are added, BUT the arch's 'partner state is replayed from raw events' principle is broken by the gamification's own rules: ladder FAIL/regression depends on pain (local-only), the Zone-2 minute depends on block RPE (local-only), and pledge XP is local-only, so two phones would derive different ladders, XP and S for the same user. Resolution chosen: minimise local inputs (talk test only for Zone-2, RIR/RPE never gate advancement) and make session.finished carry an owner-computed summary (ladders_end, steps_gained/lost, exercise_hits, zone2_min, xp_earned, xp_by_source) that partner phones consume; own phone derives and asserts. (4) The program's advance_when grammar needs 10 rule forms the closed RULES registry cannot express (checklist, multi-part targets, all-of combinators, pain-window rules, rpe_min, weeks_elapsed, drops, entry_requires-with-fallback, gap regressions, load conjuncts) and numeric step integers are fragile against the reviewer-mandated rung insertions, so steps need stable string ids. (5) Scheduling must be calendar-anchored (program_start 2026-09-14, Muster from 09-08, boss Saturdays 10-10/11-07/12-05, 04:00 day boundary), not the arch's session-count rotation, or the duel's sessions_prescribed and shared boss weeks cannot be computed. (6) Remote layout: keep the arch's log/<user>/<dev>/<yyyy-mm>.jsonl event files; every duo.json file (profile.json, weeks/<ISO>.json, badges.json, boss/<n>.json) becomes a derivation plus two new records (week.locked events; a tiny presence.json for staleness). (7) The program refutations are blocking: under the program's own rules the 53 lb bell (Hip Guard, Boss-2 warrior/champion tiers, Bronze Warrior badge, one_bell_two_warriors) is unreachable in 12 weeks for a step-1 placement, treadmill_zone2/swing id reuse corrupts ladders, and week-4 boss tests violate the run/bell gates. Not ready to build as-is; ready after a one-day M0 data reconciliation that applies the decisions listed here, after which the implementation order below puts a usable offline logger on both phones by Thu 2026-09-10 (Wed 09-09 back-filled), sync by Sat 09-12, Weekly Report by Mon 09-14, the Duel by the Tue 09-15 exhibition lock, and the Boss Arena well before Sat 10-10.

inconsistencies.between: final_arch.json data/program.json excerpt vs final_program.json (and the gamification spec that keys everything by the program's ids)
inconsistencies.issue: The arch's program is a different program: workouts A–F chosen by sessionsFinished%6, phases advanced by sessions_gte, ladders 'pushup/squat/hinge(+swing)/press/row/split-squat/carry/plank/tm-intervals/tm-zone2' with stepIds like pushup.floor and archer push-ups, an assessment {pushup style/reps, squatBw, plankSec, gobletTrial, pressTrial, hinge, walkMph, vestLb}. final_program.json has 33 exercise ids with numeric steps, a Mon–Sat weekday template, placement Q1–Q8, and the gamification's region_weights (31 ids), gear slots, badges (push_up step>=4, goblet_squat step>=8, turkish_get_up step>=3, swing kb53) and skirmish lists all reference the program's ids. None of the arch's fixture data is reusable.
inconsistencies.resolution: data/program.json is authored from final_program.json (after the program fixes) keeping the program's exercise ids, the Mon–Sat template ids (mon_lower_a, tue_upper_a, wed_heart, thu_lower_b, fri_upper_b, sat_warrior) and the Q1–Q8 placement; each step gets a stable string id plus its display ordinal; the arch's ladder/workout/assessment shapes are discarded. program.test.js parses every target string and asserts the structured A/B/unit/parts fields match it.

inconsistencies.between: Benchmark identities: final_program.json (bb_pushups_2min, bb_swings_5min, bb_mile_time, bb_hollow_hold, bb_goblet_bw, bb_vest_stepups_3min; 4 tiers recruit/soldier/warrior/champion) vs duo.json (push_max, plank_hold_s, goblet_squat_reps_at_step, swing_test 60 s, treadmill_12min_m, zone2_hold_min; tiers 0–5) vs final_arch.json (pushup-max, plank-max, squat-bw-max, mile-time, swing-form-check)
inconsistencies.issue: Three incompatible benchmark sets; the gamification's gear slots, boss strikes and badges (mile_soldier <=720 s, sub_10_mile) are written against the program's bb_* ids and tier index 0–3.
inconsistencies.resolution: Program's six bb_* ids and tier index 0–3 are canonical (duo.json's tier_pts=min(30,15*climbs) still works). The arch's 'swing-form-check' benchmark is deleted; the bell gate is the swing ladder rule (swing step 5 met x2 AND hinge_deadlift.step>=6 AND hollow_hold.step>=4, relaxed per the program refutation) and swing_form_gate_passed is derived as swing.step>=6. Each benchmark carries a 'variant' (e.g. walk-mile before treadmill_intervals.step>=3, knee push-ups x0.5, tuck hollow x0.5, implement caps) with its own tier table.

inconsistencies.between: final_arch.json engine.prescribe (workoutId = rotation[sessionsFinished % 6], phase advances only when sessions_gte satisfied, deload = trainingWeek%4==3) vs gamification streak_rules/boss_battles and final_program.json (calendar-anchored weekday template, program week 1 = Mon 2026-09-14, Muster week 0 = Tue 09-08..Sun 09-13, boss Saturdays 10-10/11-07/12-05, missed templates skipped with one make-up per week)
inconsistencies.issue: Session-count rotation cannot give two users shared boss weeks, per-week sessions_prescribed (6), zone2_min_prescribed or Perfect Week; the arch's own risk #7 admits the phones drift. The arch's weekIndex from programStart 2026-09-14 makes the Muster week index -1.
inconsistencies.resolution: Calendar-anchored: weekIndex = ISO weeks since 2026-09-14 plus 1, with week 0 = Muster (Wed–Sat, 4 quests); template chosen by weekday; deload/boss when weekIndex>0 && weekIndex%4==0; week 12 taper via week_overrides; phases by week (1–4/5–8/9–12) with the program's missed-training rules (8–14 days: -1 step all ladders, repeat week; >14: -2 steps, restart phase) replacing 'phase cannot outrun sessions'. 'Make-up: <template>' allowed once per week on a training day; 'Do a different workout' picker removed.

inconsistencies.between: Level curve and XP table: final_program.json progression_rules (XP 10/25/50, +5 per Zone-2 min /10, level=floor(sqrt(XP/100))) vs final_arch.json gamification.json (perSetDone 10, perSetTargetHit 5, allTargetsHit 40, sessionFinish 50, abandonedFinish 15, ladderAdvance 100, benchmarkPR 150, perZone2Minute 2, formCheckPass 150, restDayLogged 5; triangular base 100; ranks Recruit/Fighter/Warrior/Champion/Legend every 5 levels) vs gamification spec (xp_required(L)=round(120*(L-1)^1.5), 16 titles Recruit..Immortal, set 10/+5, quest 50/25/5, advance 100, gate 75, tier 150, Zone-2 3/min cap 45 (2/min talk-fail), interval round 12, PR 25 max 3/session, pledge 15, quiz 150, boss 30 each +20, Perfect Week 300/150 + Shield, milestones 100/300/500/1000, rekindle 50, kindle 20, duel 100/50/100, boss loot 10%/20% of xp_available_week)
inconsistencies.issue: Three different economies; the arch's allTargetsHit and restDayLogged do not exist in the final spec and rest days pay 0.
inconsistencies.resolution: The gamification spec's table, curve and titles are canonical and become data/gamification.json; the spec's 'How XP works' page renders from that file so the two can never diverge; the program's XP sentence is deleted.

inconsistencies.between: Weekly duel: final_arch.json duo.js (5 categories xp_gained, targets_hit_pct, stepsGained, zone2Min, sessions; one crown per category; leader = more crowns; ties give both crowns) vs duo.json / gamification (S = round(0.30 sessions_pct + 0.25 fidelity_pct + 0.20 zone2_pct + 0.15 progress_pct + 0.10 xp_pct), every term a capped ratio to the user's own prescription; contested/no_contest/unexplained/dead_heat/alliance; PB star; Tuesday 23:59 lock; belt and crowns replayed from locked weeks)
inconsistencies.issue: The arch's xp_gained, zone2Min and sessions are absolute quantities, exactly the failure modes #2 and #5 duo.json forbids; it has no lock, no contest status and no alliance week.
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification/duo formula is canonical. duo.js computes S from session.finished summaries plus template-derived sessions_prescribed / zone2_min_prescribed / xp_available_week (the latter needs the partner's ladders_end for interval rounds). Keep the arch's fairness test 'user with more absolute reps but lower fidelity loses'.

inconsistencies.between: Co-op bosses: final_arch.json (count metrics: The Wall sets_done 250 weeks 0–1, The Iron Bell ladder_reps 2500, The Long Road zone2 600, rewardXpEach) vs duo.json (The Couch HP 75 / The Stairwell 65 / The Fifty-Three 60; battle 1 improvement vs week-0 baseline; tiers 0–5) vs gamification (The Gatekeeper 55 / The Iron Colossus 65 / The Warlord 60 +10 Bell Strike / Iron Vest 55 +5 / Season Titan 50; battle-1 strike = 10 if logged + 15*tier_index; later imp_pts+tier_pts; damage_duo = a+b+min(a,b); FLAWLESS/DEFEATED/WOUNDED/ESCAPED; solo fallback)
inconsistencies.issue: Three boss models; only the gamification's is consistent with the program's 4-tier benchmarks and the no-week-0-benchmark rule (placement quiz is not a benchmark).
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification's boss table and formulas are canonical; boss config lives in data/gamification.json; strikes/damage/outcome derived on both phones from benchmark.recorded events (tier, tier_prev, imp_pct emitted by the owner's phone) with a boss.resolved event only to freeze the outcome.

inconsistencies.between: Streak/flame: final_arch.json gamify (missing day forgiven once per 7 + once per 30, else streak ends; duo day = both finished, both-rested forgiven once/7, any other day breaks) vs duo.json (fixed rest_weekday per user; 2 declared shields per rolling 30 days, retroactive <=48 h; break -> ember floor(streak/2) for 14 days; 5 neutral days pause, 14 break; milestones 3/7/14/30/60/90) vs gamification (rolling rest link one per 7; silent auto Shields start 1 cap 2 +1 per Perfect Week; Recovery/Away modes freeze; Ember keeps old count 7 days, full restore on 2 quests / 3 both-trained days, once per rolling 30 days; 04:00 boundary; duo neutral days, 14 neutral -> ember; milestones 7/30/66/100)
inconsistencies.issue: Three streak engines with different break, shield and milestone semantics; badges kindling_7/iron_month/automatic_66/eternal_flame and duo milestones assume the gamification version.
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification's rules are canonical; keep duo.json's one useful addition the spec omits: Recovery/Away may be declared retroactively up to 48 h (mode.started with a past start date), which the event model handles by recomputation.

inconsistencies.between: Day boundary: final_arch.json ('day: LOCAL calendar day at the phone') vs gamification ('date = (now - 4 h) local; a 00:30 session belongs to the previous day')
inconsistencies.issue: Every streak, week, month-file and duel computation keys on 'day'; a 00:30 Monday session lands in different weeks on the two definitions.
inconsistencies.resolution: util.dayKey(ts) = local calendar date of (ts - 4 h) everywhere (event.day, isoWeekKey, monthKey = day.slice(0,7) per the arch reviewer); util.test.js pins 03:59 vs 04:00 and DST nights.

inconsistencies.between: Remote layout: final_arch.json (log/<user>/<dev>/<yyyy-mm>.jsonl append-only events on orphan 'data'; no derived files) vs duo.json data_needed (users/<id>/profile.json, weeks/<ISO>.json rewritten whole, badges.json, boss/<n>.json) vs gamification (adds users/<slot>/state.json and log/<ISO>.json)
inconsistencies.issue: Two phones cannot both be right; the whole-file-rewrite layout has no merge story after a reinstall and duplicates truth (state.json) that the arch forbids.
inconsistencies.resolution: Pick the arch's event-log layout. duo.json's needs are met as derivations: profile.json -> latest profile.updated/equipment.updated (tz stripped); weeks/<ISO>.json.days -> day statuses derived from sessions + mode events + shield replay; .sessions -> session.finished summaries (session_id, date, start_time, duration_min, template_id, type, completed, exercises_prescribed/hit, exercise_hits, zone2_min, xp_earned); sessions_prescribed / zone2_min_prescribed / xp_available_week -> template + phase + mode events + partner ladders_end; ladder_steps_end / steps_gained -> summaries; benchmarks -> benchmark.recorded {tier, tier_prev, imp_pct, variant, value only if share_numbers}; reactions -> reaction.sent events; manual_no_contest -> contest.paused events; result -> week.locked events (LWW per (user, week), the record with the later partner_updated_at wins on both phones); badges.json -> derived from partner events (partner-milestone nudge diffs against a localStorage last-seen set); boss/<n>.json -> derived from benchmark.recorded + boss.resolved. Only two non-event files exist: the branch README and a per-device presence.json (see gaps).

inconsistencies.between: Derived-state ownership: final_arch.json ('ladder positions, XP, streak, scoreboard are NEVER stored; recomputed on every phone from events') vs gamification (per-set rir, pain, rpe_block are LOCAL-ONLY; FAIL = value<0.6A OR pain>=3; regress on pain>=3 twice in 7 days; a Zone-2 minute requires block RPE<=4; pledge XP counts in xp_week) and duo.json (RPE/pain/notes never synced)
inconsistencies.issue: The partner's phone cannot replay Sean's ladders, zone2_min or xp_week because their inputs never leave Sean's phone, so S, ladders_end, steps_gained and levels would differ between phones — the duel would not be deterministic.
inconsistencies.resolution: (a) Define the Zone-2 minute by talk_test_ok only (talk test is synced; RPE stays coaching data). (b) RIR/RPE never gate advancement (gamification's 'reps/time + checklist only' rule wins over the program's SESSION SUCCESS RIR clause and the arch's rpeMax 8); persistent RIR 0 in Phase 1 only shows a coaching card. (c) Pain stays the sole local input to ladders, so session.finished (public) carries an owner-computed summary {duration_min, type, completed, exercises_prescribed, exercises_hit, exercise_hits, zone2_min, interval_rounds, xp_earned, xp_by_source, ladders_end, steps_gained[], steps_lost[], pr_count, rules_version}; partner phones use it, the owner's phone re-derives and asserts equality (mismatch = bug surfaced in Settings). (d) pledge XP counts toward xp_total but is excluded from xp_week so both phones agree on S. Document as a deliberate softening of the 'never store derived' invariant: per-session summaries are immutable owner facts, not mutable counters.

inconsistencies.between: Profile switching: final_arch.json ('both users can exist on one phone; Settings -> Switch user changes settings.user only', write partitions per (user,dev)) vs gamification ('home slot is the only slot the phone writes; other profile view-only; long-press + confirm moves the write slot')
inconsistencies.issue: Different UX contracts; the arch's version has the mid-session cross-user write bug the reviewer found.
inconsistencies.resolution: Ship the gamification UX (one write slot per phone, partner view-only, long-press move for the replacement-phone case) on top of the arch's (user,dev) partitions, with the reviewer's guards (per-user activeSession, refuse switch while a session is open, dispatch rejects events whose sessionId is not in users[me]). A 'log as partner on this phone' guest mode is structurally safe under the partitions and can be added in v2.

inconsistencies.between: RIR vs RPE: final_program.json (RIR 0–4 logged per set; SESSION SUCCESS requires RIR >= phase minimum - 1) vs final_arch.json (rpe 1–10 per set; every advance rule carries rpeMax 8) vs gamification (RIR chip 0–4 once per exercise, local-only, absent from qualifying())
inconsistencies.issue: Three effort scales, and only one of them (the gamification's) is consistent with local-only privacy and cross-phone determinism.
inconsistencies.resolution: Strength rows log rir (0–4, once per exercise after its last set, default = phase target); cardio blocks log rpe_block plus talk_test_ok; both rir and rpe_block are redacted at sync; neither gates advancement (see the derived-state resolution).

inconsistencies.between: Session types: final_arch.json (session.finished | session.abandoned 'partial XP, no streak credit'; fitToTime only shrinks to 40–50 min) vs gamification (types full | skirmish | ember | kindle | boss | makeup; Ember keeps the Flame and pays +5; Skirmish 15 min counts for Flame and duel sessions >=12 min but never advances ladders)
inconsistencies.issue: The arch punishes what the gamification protects, and has no 15-minute plan builder.
inconsistencies.resolution: session.started carries type and template_id from the gamification enum; End early with >=1 working set finishes as type 'ember' (never 'abandoned'); evalLadder counts only type 'full' sessions; engine.skirmishPlan(template_day, steps) builds the 3-exercise x 3-round plan from a skirmish table in program.json.

inconsistencies.between: Set identity and fields: final_arch.json set.logged (key sessionId+ladder+setIndex, perSide flag, reps/seconds/rounds, load{kind,lb,n}, rpe, done, tempo) vs gamification set JSON (exercise_id, step, set_index, side L|R|null, value, unit reps|s|rounds|clock_s, A, B, implement_id, vest_lb, checklist_ok, rir, pain, talk_test_ok, rpe_block, met, logged, xp) plus multi-part targets (prone_ytw 'each letter', neck 'each direction', plank '1x60s + 1x45s each side')
inconsistencies.issue: The arch cannot represent a per-side row, a compound-target part, a checklist tick or a talk-test flag, all of which the XP and advance rules need.
inconsistencies.resolution: Key = (sessionId, exercise_id, setIndex, side, part); fields value/unit/A/B/implement_id/checklist_ok/talk_test_ok public; rir/pain/pain_region/rpe_block/vest_lb private via field-level redaction; met/logged/xp derived, never stored.

inconsistencies.between: Vest loading: final_program.json (vest = % bodyweight rounded to the vest increment, first session min(10% BW, 10 lb), cap min(20% BW, 30 lb); bodyweight is local-only) vs final_arch.json (fixed steps vest:10 / vest:20 in requires; equipment vestLb list)
inconsistencies.issue: The arch's fixed-pound vest rungs ignore the program's % BW rule and Cat's size; the program's rule needs bodyweight, which must not sync.
inconsistencies.resolution: Steps declare vest as a percent (vest_pct 10|15|20, cap_lb 30); engine.resolveVest(pct, bodyweight_local, equipment{vest_min_lb, vest_increment_lb, vest_max_lb}) runs on the owner's phone; the set stores vest_lb locally and it is redacted at sync (a vest weight is bodyweight x0.10 rounded, i.e. a body metric); the partner sees the step name only.

inconsistencies.between: Deload and taper: final_arch.json (volumeScale 0.6 ceil min 2; fatigue deload from missedTargetsInRow 3 or mean sessionRpe >= 8.5) vs final_program.json deload_rules (x0.6 round DOWN min 2, RIR 4, Thursday swing sets cut to 3, Wednesday Zone-2 at 70% one incline lower, finisher walks kept; week 12 taper Mon–Wed 50% sets, Thu 25-min walk, Fri off; auto-deload from FAILs, readiness check-in, sleep, pain flags) vs gamification (deload = 0.6-set weeks 4/8/12 with Training Camp; zone2_min_prescribed 'deload week: Wed at 70%'; Perfect Week counts 6 quests every week)
inconsistencies.issue: Rounding differs, per-day deload specifics and the week-12 taper exist only as prose, and the gamification's sessions_prescribed=6 is wrong for week 12 (Fri off -> 5).
inconsistencies.resolution: program.json carries a structured deload object (set_multiplier 0.6 round-down min 2, rir 4, thu_swing_sets 3, wed_zone2_pct 70, wed_incline_delta -1) and week_overrides (week 12: mon–wed set_multiplier 0.5, thu template 'walk_25', fri off); sessions_prescribed and zone2_min_prescribed are computed from these; auto-deload v1 uses only the FAIL and pain triggers (readiness/sleep check-in deferred; no screen exists for it in the gamification spec).

inconsistencies.between: Sunday walk: final_program.json ('Duo streak counts a logged walk as trained') vs gamification ('a Kindle walk on a rest day keeps status rest; rest-day training adds no flame or duo day; Kindle >=20 min = +20 XP + Zone-2 minutes')
inconsistencies.issue: Contradictory streak semantics for the one optional day.
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification wins: type 'kindle' sessions never change day status and never count for the duel's sessions_completed.

inconsistencies.between: Duo badge ids: duo.json (duo_ninety 'Season of Fire', rekindled, boss_slayer 'First Blood', boss_flawless, synergy_carry 'Indispensable', hundred_ninety '190 Club', zone2_pair 'Two Hearts', iron_block 'Iron Block') vs gamification badges (season_of_fire, rekindled_duo, duo_slayers 'Slayers', duo_flawless, indispensable, club_190; solo first_blood = first completed quest; no Two Hearts / Iron Block)
inconsistencies.issue: Same badges under different ids, one name collision (First Blood), two duo.json badges dropped without a stated reason.
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification ids are canonical; add zone2_pair (4 consecutive weeks both zone2_pct==100) and iron_block (both users sessions_completed >= sum(sessions_prescribed) - 2 within a 4-week block) since both are machine-checkable from synced data.

inconsistencies.between: Boss-day splitting: final_program.json ('if it runs long the app moves the mile to Sunday') vs gamification ('tests 5–6 move to the next training day; rematches never on the rest day') vs program refutation ('one treadmill cannot host two 13-min mile tests inside a 48-min script; schedule the second user's mile on Sunday')
inconsistencies.issue: Sunday is the rest day in the gamification's rule set, yet the program and the reviewer both need it for the mile.
inconsistencies.resolution: Any boss test may be logged on the Sunday of boss week (it is inside the 14-day window and boss week is a deload week); the Sunday keeps status 'rest' for the Flame; rematches still replace a training day's conditioning block only.

inconsistencies.between: Within-step prefill: final_program.json ('prescribe A on the first session; beat last time by >= 1 total rep') vs final_arch.json ('clamp(lastMinReps+1, lo, hi) when allDone else lo') vs gamification ('prefill = last logged value per set at this exercise+step, A when the step just changed; headline beat last time by >= 1 total rep')
inconsistencies.issue: Three prefill rules; only the gamification's makes the one-tap 'match or beat' loop work per set.
inconsistencies.resolution: Gamification's rule; program.json step targets carry [A,B]; the plan's per-row prefill comes from the user's perf history at that step id.

inconsistencies.between: Screens/navigation: final_arch.json (tabs Today, Duo, Progress, History, Settings; body.js = body-metrics screen) vs gamification (Home, Quest, Quest Complete, Body & Armory, Ladders, Boss Arena, Duel & Crown Cabinet, Journal + Weekly Report, Badges, Settings; progressive unlock)
inconsistencies.issue: File names collide (body.js) and the arch has no Ladders, Armory, Boss Arena, Weekly Report or Badges surfaces.
inconsistencies.resolution: Five tabs: Home, Body (silhouette + Armory + Ladders), Duo (Duel + Boss Arena), Journal (calendar, sessions, PR board, Weekly Report, Badges), Settings (incl. body metrics + modes + sync); views: home.js, session.js, complete.js, body.js, ladders.js, duel.js, boss.js, journal.js, badges.js, settings.js, setup.js; tab visibility follows the progressive-unlock schedule (pure function of derived state).

gaps.gap: The program refutations are blocking and none is applied: hinge_deadlift trained once/week makes the BELL GATE unreachable in 12 weeks for a step-1 placement (so Hip Guard stays Iron, Boss-2 warrior/champion tiers, goblet_53, century_bell, simple_swing, one_bell_two_warriors and Bronze Warrior are unreachable); treadmill_zone2 is reused for 3/7/8/4-minute walks against a 30-min ladder target (auto-advance or auto-regress every week); swing on Saturday runs a different prescription under the same id so 'x2 consecutive' never completes; week-4 mile and 5-min swing tests violate the RUN and BELL gates; 19 targets and 34 advance_when forms are prose; vest gates are off by one; five 53 lb steps have no hinge gate; no on-ramp; intervals break their own 10% rule; several blocks overrun their minutes.
gaps.fix: Apply the refutation fixes in program.json v2 before writing engine code: hinge_deadlift added to Thu strength A (3 sets), bell gate relaxed to hinge_deadlift.step >= 5 x2, checklist-only steps advance on x1, deload weeks keep counting toward x2; new ids zone2_finisher (Mon/Thu/Sat/Wed-warm-up, no ladder effect) and swing_density (Saturday, own ladder with entry requires) — the gamification's Zone-2 tally and skirmish lists must be updated to include zone2_finisher; benchmark variants (walk-mile with its own tiers until treadmill_intervals.step >= 3; swing test locked below swing.step 3); entry_requires on every 53 lb step and on swing step 1 with a template fallback; weeks 0–2 at 0.6 sets; intervals reshaped 8->9->10->11 hard minutes; zone2 step 0 (20 min); Q1 10–14 -> push_up 4. Add test/program.test.js 'reachability': simulate a perfect all-1 user and assert swing.step >= 6 by week 9 and every gear slot reachable to Bronze by boss 3.

gaps.gap: The closed registry (all_sets_reps_gte, min_reps_lt, time_gte, min_time_lt, rounds_gte, total_reps_within, cardio_done, sessions_gte, benchmark_gte/lte, ladder_at_or_past) cannot express: checklist conjuncts (hinge 1–5, swing, goblet 1, TGU 'clean' = 3/3, hollow 1 'back flat'); multi-part targets (prone_ytw each letter, neck each direction, plank '1x60s + 1x45s each side'); all-of combinators (pike step 6 '3x30s + 3x12'); 'no low-back pain flag in 14 days', 'no shin/knee pain flag', 'completed pain-free'; a minimum RPE (intervals step 1 'hard reps RPE >= 6'); 'and 2 weeks elapsed'; '0 drops' (TGU 2); load conjuncts ('>= 15 at 12 lb' on dual-load steps); entry requirements on the CURRENT step evaluated every session with a fallback exercise (swing step 1 requires hinge >= 3); the program's regression triggers (any set < 0.6A, pain >= 3 twice in 7 days, swing checklist misses); the '> 7-day gap: no advance' and 8–14 / >14-day regression rules; the time-guard 'dropped set is not prescribed'.
